sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus loves me! This I know,
For the Bible tells me so;
Little ones to Him belong;
They are weak, but He is strong.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Anna B. Warner, 1860.

sections.label: Song
lines: Jesus loves the little children,
All the children of the world;
Every color, every race,
All are covered by His grace;
Jesus loves the little children of the world.

verification.note: Public-domain text based on C. Herbert Woolston's 1913 hymn.

songs.title: Praise Him, All Ye Little Children

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise Him, praise Him,
All ye little children;
God is love, God is love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thank Him, thank Him,
All ye little children;
God is love, God is love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Serve Him, serve Him,
All ye little children;
God is love, God is love.

verification.note: Public-domain children's hymn by Carey Bonner, 1900.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful,
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Each little flower that opens,
Each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colors,
He made their tiny wings.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Cecil F. Alexander, 1848.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head;
The stars in the bright sky looked down where He lay,
The little Lord Jesus, asleep on the hay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Be near me, Lord Jesus; I ask Thee to stay
Close by me forever, and love me, I pray;
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care,
And fit us for heaven, to live with Thee there.

verification.note: Public-domain Christmas hymn, first published 1885.

songs.title: I've Got Peace Like a River

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I've got peace like a river,
I've got peace like a river,
I've got peace like a river in my soul.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I've got joy like a fountain,
I've got joy like a fountain,
I've got joy like a fountain in my soul.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I've got love like an ocean,
I've got love like an ocean,
I've got love like an ocean in my soul.

verification.note: Traditional African American spiritual; public-domain text.

songs.title: He's Got the Whole World in His Hands

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He's got the whole world in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He's got the little tiny baby in His hands,
He's got the little tiny baby in His hands,
He's got the little tiny baby in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands.

verification.note: Traditional African American spiritual; public-domain text.

songs.title: This Train Is Bound for Glory

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This train is bound for glory, this train;
This train is bound for glory, this train;
This train is bound for glory,
Don't carry nothing but the righteous and the holy;
This train is bound for glory, this train.

verification.note: Traditional spiritual; public-domain text.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We are climbing Jacob's ladder,
We are climbing Jacob's ladder,
We are climbing Jacob's ladder,
Soldiers of the cross.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Every round goes higher, higher,
Every round goes higher, higher,
Every round goes higher, higher,
Soldiers of the cross.

verification.note: Traditional African American spiritual; public-domain text.

songs.title: Joshua Fit the Battle of Jericho

sections.label: Song
lines: Joshua fit the battle of Jericho, Jericho, Jericho;
Joshua fit the battle of Jericho,
And the walls came tumbling down.

verification.note: Traditional spiritual; public-domain text.

songs.title: Go, Tell It on the Mountain

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Go, tell it on the mountain,
Over the hills and everywhere;
Go, tell it on the mountain
That Jesus Christ is born.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: While shepherds kept their watching
O'er silent flocks by night,
Behold throughout the heavens
There shone a holy light.

verification.note: Traditional spiritual compiled by John W. Work Jr.; public-domain text.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Swing low, sweet chariot,
Coming for to carry me home;
Swing low, sweet chariot,
Coming for to carry me home.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I looked over Jordan, and what did I see,
Coming for to carry me home?
A band of angels coming after me,
Coming for to carry me home.

verification.note: Traditional African American spiritual; public-domain text.

songs.title: When the Saints Go Marching In

sections.label: Song
lines: O when the saints go marching in,
O when the saints go marching in,
O Lord, I want to be in that number
When the saints go marching in.

verification.note: Traditional gospel song; public-domain text.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Give me that old-time religion,
Give me that old-time religion,
Give me that old-time religion,
It's good enough for me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It was good for Paul and Silas,
It was good for Paul and Silas,
It was good for Paul and Silas,
And it's good enough for me.

verification.note: Traditional gospel song; public-domain text.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Oh! Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?

verification.note: Traditional African American spiritual; public-domain text.

sections.label: Song
lines: I'm gonna lay down my burden
Down by the riverside,
Down by the riverside,
Down by the riverside;
I'm gonna lay down my burden
Down by the riverside,
And study war no more.

verification.note: Traditional African American spiritual; public-domain text.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Michael, row the boat ashore, hallelujah!
Michael, row the boat ashore, hallelujah!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jordan's river is deep and wide, hallelujah!
Milk and honey on the other side, hallelujah!

verification.note: Traditional African American spiritual; public-domain text.

songs.title: I Think When I Read That Sweet Story of Old

lines: I think when I read that sweet story of old,
When Jesus was here among men,
How He called little children as lambs to His fold,
I should like to have been with Him then.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Jemima Luke, 1841.

lines: Standing by a purpose true,
Heeding God's command,
Honor them, the faithful few!
All hail to Daniel's band!
Dare to be a Daniel!
Dare to stand alone!
Dare to have a purpose firm!
Dare to make it known!

verification.note: Public-domain hymn by Philip P. Bliss, 1873.

lines: Jesus bids us shine with a clear, pure light,
Like a little candle burning in the night;
In this world of darkness, so we must shine,
You in your small corner, and I in mine.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Susan Warner, 1859.

songs.title: Jesus Wants Me for a Sunbeam

lines: Jesus wants me for a sunbeam,
To shine for Him each day;
In every way try to please Him,
At home, at school, at play.
A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
Jesus wants me for a sunbeam;
A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
I'll be a sunbeam for Him.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Nellie Talbot, 1899.

songs.title: I Am So Glad That Jesus Loves Me

lines: I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tells of His love in the Book He has given;
Wonderful things in the Bible I see;
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me;
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

verification.note: Public-domain hymn by Philip P. Bliss, 1871.

lines: Count your blessings, name them one by one;
Count your blessings, see what God hath done;
Count your blessings, name them one by one;
Count your many blessings, see what God hath done.

verification.note: Public-domain hymn by Johnson Oatman Jr., 1897.

lines: Trust and obey, for there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

verification.note: Public-domain hymn by John H. Sammis, 1887.

lines: Leaning, leaning, safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning, leaning on the everlasting arms.

verification.note: Public-domain hymn by Elisha A. Hoffman, 1887.

lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, holy, holy! Merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

verification.note: Public-domain text by Reginald Heber, 1826.

lines: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee,
God of glory, Lord of love;
Hearts unfold like flowers before Thee,
Opening to the sun above.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Henry van Dyke, 1907.

lines: Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Fanny J. Crosby, 1873.

lines: To God be the glory, great things He hath done;
So loved He the world that He gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life an atonement for sin,
And opened the life gate that all may go in.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Fanny J. Crosby, 1875.

songs.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus

lines: What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!

verification.note: Public-domain text by Joseph M. Scriven, 1855.

lines: Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure;
Save from wrath and make me pure.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Augustus M. Toplady, 1776.

lines: Onward, Christian soldiers, marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus going on before!
Christ, the royal Master, leads against the foe;
Forward into battle, see His banner go!

verification.note: Public-domain text by Sabine Baring-Gould, 1865.

songs.title: Stand Up, Stand Up for Jesus

lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner, it must not suffer loss;
From victory unto victory His army shall He lead,
Till every foe is vanquished and Christ is Lord indeed.

verification.note: Public-domain text by George Duffield Jr., 1858.

lines: Crown Him with many crowns, the Lamb upon His throne;
Hark! how the heavenly anthem drowns all music but its own!
Awake, my soul, and sing of Him who died for thee,
And hail Him as thy matchless King through all eternity.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Matthew Bridges, 1851.

songs.title: Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing

lines: Come, Thou Fount of every blessing, tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Streams of mercy, never ceasing, call for songs of loudest praise;
Teach me some melodious sonnet, sung by flaming tongues above;
Praise the mount! I'm fixed upon it, mount of Thy redeeming love.

verification.note: Public-domain text by Robert Robinson, 1758.

songs.title: I Sing the Mighty Power of God

lines: I sing the mighty power of God that made the mountains rise,
That spread the flowing seas abroad and built the lofty skies;
I sing the wisdom that ordained the sun to rule the day;
The moon shines full at His command, and all the stars obey.

verification.note: Public-domain children's hymn by Isaac Watts, 1715.
